name: soundcrate
description: Dig, curate and reorder your SoundCloud playlists: search by genre, BPM or upload date, find related tracks and artists, build private playlists and order them by BPM or Camelot key. Runs locally; guided setup.

go_plus.title: I have SoundCloud Go+
go_plus.description: Turn on if your SoundCloud account has Go+, so SoundCrate treats Go+ catalogue tracks as playable in full (label tracks usually are, with no guarantee for your region or rights). SoundCloud does not report this, so you have to tell it.
